glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形): a nose — original form of 鼻 (“nose”). Later phonetically borrowed as an instance of jiajie (假借 phonetic loan) for 自 (“oneself; from”). Folk etymology considers the meaning to arise from a habit of pointing at one’s nose to indicate oneself.
senses: only used in 潮州音樂——自己顧自己
